summary: Exported the two-file unified diff and applied it cleanly to a fresh copy with a dry-run check followed by apply. One scripted matrix then ran against the patched fresh copy and the unpatched pristine source with the same disposable origin, wrapper, hook directory, and marker path. The pristine source executed markers for leading-space upload-pack, abbreviated upload-pack, shorter abbreviated upload-pack, and abbreviated config with a hook path. The patched copy blocked eight attack rows with no marker. Both copies completed eight benign rows: ordinary, depth, single-branch, branch, recurse-submodules, no-checkout, quiet, and filter-blob-none; no-checkout correctly had no working file. Direct helper checks accepted a benign list and blocked exact, abbreviated, and short unsafe forms. Test recipe: fresh copy, dry-run apply, one local origin per environment, clone once per row, and compare rejection, completion, marker presence, and working-file presence. A patch-evaluation JSONL and the host command were saved. This is local supporting evidence only; the official benchmark has not run.
